title: Standardise interaction state handling across all screens
rationale: 1466 buttons are declared ad hoc; each one independently re-implements pending/error/disabled handling, so the behaviour is inconsistent by construction.
current: pending state, error toast and confirmation are decided per screen.
proposal: give the Button primitive a built-in `pending` state that disables itself, and require mutations to pass through one `useMutation` helper that always toasts success and failure.
benefit: removes 1189 hand-rolled pending checks and makes double-submission impossible
